mapper.select:
select PORTFOLIO_ID code, PORTFOLIO_NAME shortName from PTL_PORTFOLIO
and (instr(PORTFOLIO_ID, #{param}) > 0 or instr(PORTFOLIO_NAME, #{param}) > 0)

select FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID id, FINPROD_MARKET_ID || ':' || FINPROD_ABBR text from FIN_PRODUCT where FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodTypeProd}
and (FINPROD_MARKET_ID like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%') or FINPROD_ABBR like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%'))

select STL_CAPACCT_INFO.ACCT_NO id, STL_CAPACCT_INFO.ACCT_NO || ':' || STL_CAPACCT_INFO.ACCT_NAME text from STL_CAPACCT_INFO,STL_FIN_PRODUCT_ACCT where STL_CAPACCT_INFO.ACCT_NO = STL_FIN_PRODUCT_ACCT.ACCT_NO
and (STL_CAPACCT_INFO.ACCT_NO like concat(concat('%', #{search}), '%') or STL_CAPACCT_INFO.ACCT_NAME like concat(concat('%', #{search}), '%'))
and STL_CAPACCT_INFO.ACCT_NO IN (#{initValue})
GROUP BY STL_CAPACCT_INFO.ACCT_NO,STL_CAPACCT_INFO.ACCT_NAME

SELECT CUSTOMER_ID id, CUSTOMER_NAME text FROM MST_CUSTOMER_INFO WHERE IS_TRUSTER = 'Y'
and (CUSTOMER_ID like concat(concat('%', #{search}), '%') or CUSTOMER_NAME like concat(concat('%', #{search}), '%'))
select from STL_PAY_ORDERS where TRADE_ID = #{tradeId}
select from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL where TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId}
select from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD where exists (select 1 from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL where TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD.TRADE_ID = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID and TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId})
select from PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL where exists (select 1 from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL where PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID and TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId})
select from PTL_TRADE where exists (select 1 from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL where PTL_TRADE.BUSI_NO = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID and TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId})
mapper.update: update TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL set IS_CANCEL = #{isCancle} WHERE TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId}
mapper.select: select from trd_trade_fee_detail fee where exists (select 1 from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL deal where fee.trade_id = deal.trade_id and deal.totle_trade_id = #{tradeId})
SELECT FINPROD_ID from FIN_PRODUCT where P_FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select SEC_ACCT_ID secAcctId, SEC_ACCT_NAME secAcctName, SEC_ACCT_SOURCE secAcctSource, REGIST_ORG registOrg, TRD_ACCT_ID trdAcctId, TRD_ACCT_CCY trdAcctCcy, REC_ACCT_ID recAcctId, REC_ACCT_CCY recAcctCcy, REMARK remark from STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO
SELECT USER_NAME userName FROM SYS_USER
mapper.delete: delete from fin_cash_info where FINPROD_ID = #{portfolioId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and FINPROD_TYPE=#{finProdType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.select: select fee_id from mst_feeinfo where fee_type=#{feeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and rownum =1

SELECT CUSTOMER_ID id, CUSTOMER_NAME text, CUSTOMER_TYPE||',' || IS_ISSUER || ',' || IS_FINANCIER || ',' || IS_ASSTE_MANAGER || ',' || IS_TRUSTER || ',' || IS_GUARANTEE || ',' || IS_PLEDGOR || ',' || IS_SALER || ',' || IS_DEPOSIT_BANK || ',' || IS_INVEST_ADVISER object FROM MST_CUSTOMER_INFO where 1=1
AND IS_TRUSTER IS NOT NULL
and (CUSTOMER_ID like concat(concat('%', #{search}), '%') or CUSTOMER_NAME like concat(concat('%', #{search}), '%'))
and CUSTOMER_ID = #{initValue}
